description: Returns structured semantic DOM content for the main document and accessible child frames when the accessibility tree is insufficient.

pageId.description: Page ID whose DOM structure should be inspected.

selector.description: Unique CSS selector for the DOM root.

maxParentDepth.description: Maximum number of DOM parents to include above the target. Ignored when neither id nor selector is provided.

maxSubtreeDepth.description: Maximum DOM descendant depth to include.

purpose.description: Use this when DOM.getAXTree does not expose the DOM element you need. id and selector stay at the top level; omit both to inspect the document. context.maxParentDepth is ignored for a document-root request. Element bounds and scroll metrics use CSS pixels; bounds are local to each returned Frame viewport, and visible does not prove hit-testability.

rootFrameId.description: Frame ID of the returned document root.

frames.description: Structured semantic trees for the root document and accessible child frames.

summary.description: Node counts, truncation, and visibility summary.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used when a target was requested.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.

suggested_prompt.description: Action-specific next-step guidance based on the returned result.

rootFrameId.description: Frame ID of the returned document root.

frames.description: Structured semantic trees for the root document and accessible child frames.

summary.description: Node counts, truncation, and visibility summary.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used when a target was requested.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Factual observation that does not expose private runtime diagnostics.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Action-specific public details; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
